controls.label: Color
controls.qualification: Color from a measured spectrum of the star (Kiehling 1987, relative calibration); darkening toward the edge from a published law. No image of the surface exists.
controls.notes: The color of Alpha Centauri B's spectrum as Kiehling (1987) measured it from the ground, 320-880 nm with a relative calibration; the observation date is not published. No resolved image of the surface is cast; the display axis is celestial north, a convention. The darkening toward the edge is the power law I(mu) = mu^0.1545 that Kervella et al. (2017), A&A 597, A137 fit to the star's resolved disc (VLTI/PIONIER H band, 1.65 um; not a visible band).
